profile.setting: Residential care — Mum's care home (the care-home group)
profile.monitoringModel: Sample: no portal exists on the home's side, so oversight runs on a structured email + phone protocol, a contact log and a family well-being tracker, connected through a dedicated WhatsApp group.

cadence.what: Phone call to senior on duty
cadence.detail: Same day/time each week; use the questions checklist; log the call with follow-ups.
Use the template below; log the response and any follow-ups.
Request minutes; compare against previous review (sample).

questionsChecklist: How has Mum been this week — mood and engagement? (sample)
Any falls, skin concerns or changes in eating? (sample)
Any new medication or appointment to note? (sample)
escalation: 1. Senior on duty — same-day phone conversation, logged.
2. Home manager — email with specifics and dates (template in Mum's tab).
3. Care-home group regional support — via the operator's contact route, referencing dates.
4. CQC — report a concern online if unresolved (sample).
whatsappPlan: Create the group 'Mum — family & care home' and invite the manager + key family members.
Pin a short communication-protocol message (weekly call day, who to contact, what counts as urgent).

emailTemplates.title: Monthly wellbeing update request
emailTemplates.subject: Mum — monthly family update request (sample)
emailTemplates.body:
Dear [manager name],

Could you please send us this month's written update for Mum? We're especially interested in mood, engagement, appetite and any falls or skin concerns.

Many thanks,
The family (sample template)
